SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_name AS employeeName, age, passwords, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y%m%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y%m%d') AS endDate FROM employee
AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%') AND age >= #{ageFrom} AND age <= #{ageTo}
AND start_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDateFrom}, '%Y%m%d')
AND start_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDateTo}, '%Y%m%d')
AND end_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDateFrom}, '%Y%m%d')
AND end_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDateTo}, '%Y%m%d')
